commit.message: Update the libjsig description and refactor the version query code

Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream-9/code-reflection' into tile-arch-check

Change-Id: Ibc2468ffab7577d6fe7b777d6bfda56db1071f7d

Check the GPU architecture before Tile compilation

HAT compiles generated CUDA source with nvcc or NVRTC. Tile code
generation starts at sm_80. Both compilers now read the device compute
capability in one place and reject Tile compilation on older GPUs before
the compiler runs. The generated CUDA source is saved first, and the
error names that file.
